## PENDING CARE SETTING CONSOLIDATION
This page is pending SME review to merge inpatient/outpatient/ER-UC guidance into a single combined recommendation. Until that review is complete, each care setting's original content is shown separately below.
## INPATIENT:
# PREVENTION OF ANTIVIRAL INFECTIONS IN A PATIENT WITH MALIGNANCY

# **Stem cell transplant recipients (autologous or allogeneic)

Usually the standard prophylaxis and monitoring strategies recommended

by the institution performing the stem cell transplant will be

followed.

# Consult Hematology-Oncology or Infectious Disease for recommendations.

# Rituximab Therapy

Recommend routine testing for Hepatitis B prior to initiating treatment

with Rituximab.

[Select for Hepatitis B recommendations](antiviral-infection-malignancy)

# References:

Vega, J et al, J Clin Oncol 26: 2008 (May 20 suppl, abstract 8558)
